newsitem.title: USA: Outboard says knows no reason for stock jump. [CORRECTED 23:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Outboard says knows no reason for stock jump. [CORRECTED 23:15 GMT]

text.p: Outboard Marine Corp said it had made no announcements and knew of no specific reason for its stock being up 1-1/4 to 12-7/8.
A spokeswoman for the Waukegan, Ill.-based powerboat and powerboat engine maker said the company was unaware of a cause for the rise, driven by heavy block trading volume.

Outboard made a two-year low of 10-3/4 on Monday after it announced second-quarter results that disappointed Wall Street. The company also said it had hired Salomon Brothers to help it explore strategic options, a move that initially puzzled some industry analysts.
On Tuesday, Standard & Poor's and on Monday, Moody's, lowered Outboard's credit ratings.
(Corrects to make clear Moody's changed rating on Monday, not Tuesday.)
